name: Decision Matrix
description: Decision Matrix is an MCP connector that lets Claude evaluate choices using explicit criteria, weights, and scoring rules instead of ad‑hoc opinions. Teams can define matrices for vendor selection, feature prioritization, RFP evaluation, risk assessment, or any decision that needs a structured, defensible process. Given a set of options and criteria, Decision Matrix guides Claude to score each option, explain the rationale behind every score, and highlight tradeoffs and sensitivity to changing weights. This makes it easier for product, operations, procurement, and proposal teams to move from “gut feel” to documented, auditable decisions that stand up to stakeholder scrutiny. Decision Matrix is maintained by Reasoning.Services and is designed to work alongside other MCP servers that provide document access, workflows, or additional reasoning tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Decision Matrix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Decision Matrix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://reasoning.services/tools/decision-matrix/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Decision Matrix MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decision Matrix provides these MCP tools: add_criterion_tool, add_option_tool, current_session_tool, detect_disagreements_tool, evaluate_options_tool, get_decision_matrix_tool, and start_decision_analysis_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Decision Matrix?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Decision Matrix in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Decision Matrix MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decision Matrix requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Decision Matrix is developed by Reasoning.Services. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
